title: Rally with consolidation
description: Four bullish breaks of structure as price rallies from 22.1k to 25.1k over 15 and 16 Feb 2023: 22,812, 22,980, 24,329 and 25,077. The last comes after half a day of sideways trade under the 24.7k high; the final candle's close breaks above it and confirms the swing.
